copyright_policy: Only original short summaries, workflow guidance, risks, and verification expectations are stored. Linked tutorial text, transcripts, videos, course files, and code are not redistributed.

sources.title: SOP attributes and VEX data contracts
sources.author: Matt Estela; Moritz
sources.summary: Treat attribute owner, type, size, and naming as explicit contracts before VEX reads or writes them.

sources.title: VEX topology and spatial query patterns
sources.author: Matt Estela; Moeen Sayed
sources.summary: Choose topology traversal or proximity search deliberately and validate returned indices before geometry edits.

sources.title: Procedural curve modeling and sweep frames
sources.author: Moritz; Susie Green
sources.summary: Build stable curve parameterization, orientation, and width attributes before sweeping or copying geometry.

sources.title: Pyro field sourcing, bounds, and cache contracts
sources.author: Matt Estela; Mark Spevick
sources.summary: Audit source-to-field mappings, sparse bounds, resolution, and cached fields as one reproducible Pyro contract.

sources.title: FLIP scale, collision, reseeding, and cache checks
sources.author: Sergio Neza; Svava Jóhannsdóttir
sources.summary: Validate scale, particle coverage, collision separation, reseeding, and cache continuity before judging a FLIP result.

sources.title: Vellum constraint and solver evidence
sources.author: Matt Estela; Rohan Dalvi
sources.summary: Inspect constraint geometry and solve quality separately from rendered surface geometry.

sources.title: RBD packed pieces and constraint networks
sources.author: Matt Estela; Akil Tasi
sources.summary: Keep packed-piece identities and constraint endpoints consistent through fracture, solve, breakage, and unpacking.

sources.title: KineFX hierarchy and transform contracts
sources.author: Matt Estela; bubble pins
sources.summary: Validate joint identity, parent ordering, rest transforms, and local/world transform conversions before deformation.

sources.title: Solaris USD scene assembly and lighting
sources.author: Matt Estela; Berika Lobzhanidze
sources.summary: Make prim paths, layer opinions, payloads, materials, cameras, and lights inspectable at the composed stage.

sources.title: MaterialX and Karma lookdev validation
sources.author: Rohan Dalvi; Moeen Sayed
sources.summary: Separate shader graph correctness, coordinate contracts, material binding, and renderer support when validating lookdev.

sources.title: Copernicus layer, resolution, and color contracts
sources.author: Matt Estela; Moeen Sayed
sources.summary: Track layer names, planes, resolution, data ranges, and color transforms explicitly through Copernicus graphs.

sources.title: PDG TOP work-item and artifact contracts
sources.author: Matt Estela; Daniel Lee
sources.summary: Design work-item attributes and file dependencies so dirtying, cooking, and artifact verification are deterministic.

sources.title: HDA interface, versioning, and dependency checks
sources.author: Matt Estela; Delano Athias
sources.summary: Treat an HDA as a versioned interface whose parameters, internal paths, outputs, and dependencies require explicit checks.

sources.title: Viewer State interaction and undo boundaries
sources.author: Mohamad Salame; minami110
sources.summary: Keep state registration, selection, device events, parameter writes, and undo scopes independently observable.

sources.title: Performance profiling before optimization
sources.author: Richard Thomas; Matt Estela
sources.summary: Measure representative cooks, find the dominant stage, then change data movement or algorithmic cost with before/after evidence.

sources.title: Cache minimization and debugging evidence
sources.author: VFX Magic / Hiral Joraval; Mohamed Nagy
sources.summary: Cache only reconstruction-critical data and record frame coverage, file evidence, load mode, and reconstruction checks.
